name: Summer Youth Enrichment Program (SYEP)
org: Prince George's County Government, Office of Human Resources Management
what_you_do: Get a paid summer job for 6 weeks in Prince George's County. You might work at a nonprofit, a company, or a county office. You also learn job skills and try out careers.
who_can_apply: Prince George's County youth and young adults ages 14 to 24 (your age as of the program start date picks which application you fill out). Placements are by random lottery.
pay_detail: Paid. Some placements are hourly and some are stipends; the county page does not state a rate.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications March 1 to March 31, 2026 (11:59 pm); program July 6 to August 14, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted, but the page says applications are accepted March 1 to March 31.
how_to_apply: Apply online during March through the county's NEOGOV job site, choosing the application for your age group (14 and 15, 16 and 17, or 18 to 24). Eligible applicants go into a random lottery. Ages 18 to 24 are encouraged to attach a resume. Questions: syep@co.pg.md.us.
notes: Not everyone gets a job. To get ready, set up an email and voicemail, open a bank account, and have your Social Security Number and address ready. Teens who did SYEP can later try the county's Youth@Work Internship at 18. In Maryland, all teens under 18 need a work permit after they get a job offer.
